about_the_game:
Anyone can enjoy it!

Cute cat clicker game

A simple and refreshing cat punching game that both adults and children can enjoy is here!

All you have to do is tap, so even beginners can play with confidence!

(But if you're not careful, you might get tossed around by the mice!?)

Become a cat and hone your punching skills! Aim to be the strongest professional cat puncher!

Have fun playing in three modes!

[Mouse Whacking Mode]

Tap the mice that appear one after another! Become a cat and defeat the mice!

[Peanut Mode]

Tap the peanuts that the mice throw at you in good tempo to destroy them! You'll get addicted to the speed!

[Prank Mode]

Relieve stress by smashing things in your room! Challenge yourself to see how many you can destroy within the time limit!
